observation.desktop: Live Amazon.co.jp page inspected in Chrome at 1440 x 1000; 9 gallery items and 8 major A+ containers recorded.
observation.mobile: The same live page inspected at a 390 x 844 browser viewport; Amazon retained a fixed desktop-width content region in this environment.

Reference images and competitor copy are observation evidence only and are not packaged into the reusable Skill.

gallery_patterns.consumer_question: 本体とステーションはどのような構成か

gallery_patterns.benefit: 設置物の全体構成を最初に理解できる
gallery_patterns.why_effective: 高複雑度な製品群を一つのシステムとして認識させる。

gallery_patterns.consumer_question: 掃除性能の中心的な強みは何か

gallery_patterns.why_effective: ユーザーの不満である汚れ移りを機構で解く。

gallery_patterns.consumer_question: ゴミをどこまで吸えるか

gallery_patterns.why_effective: 数値を実際のゴミ例に接続し、意味を補う。

gallery_patterns.consumer_question: 壁際や角まで掃除できるか

gallery_patterns.consumer_question: ステーションは何を自動化するか

gallery_patterns.consumer_question: 障害物を避け、効率よく走れるか

gallery_patterns.why_effective: 重要な不安を網羅する一方、認識・経路・アプリが競合している。

gallery_patterns.consumer_question: 従来の回転モップより何が良いか

gallery_patterns.benefit: 方式選択の理由を理解できる
gallery_patterns.why_effective: 主要USPを競合方式との差へ戻して締める。

visual_patterns.visual_hierarchy: Large numeric performance claims lead; mechanism diagrams and multi-callout panels follow.
visual_patterns.information_density: High to very high across most gallery and A+ units.
visual_patterns.image_text_ratio: Roughly 50:50, often with text embedded inside diagrams.
visual_patterns.whitespace: Low; panels prioritize coverage over breathing room.
visual_patterns.full_bleed_usage: Frequent blue and dark technical fields.
visual_patterns.card_usage: Cards and callouts enumerate mechanisms and station functions.
visual_patterns.product_scale: Large for robot and station, medium inside navigation diagrams.
visual_patterns.typography_hierarchy: Large blue/white claim, several medium labels and many small annotations.
visual_patterns.dark_light_rhythm: Dark hero and navigation bars alternate with pale technical panels, but density remains constant.
visual_patterns.scene_technical_rhythm: Technical chapters dominate; lifestyle scenes are secondary proof contexts.

strengths: 机制解释紧贴用户痛点
从清洁核心到基站再到导航有完整技术链
性能数字与典型污物、墙角等场景连接
系列比较提供明确选择入口
weaknesses: 信息密度长期处于高位
单张图多次出现功能清单和小字
A+四组导航轮播的视觉变化不足
规格长文造成疲劳，390px viewport裁切风险明显
use: 把核心清洁问题拆成机制—性能—覆盖—维护链路
技术Claim后立即呈现失效场景或可见结果
复杂系统按核心机构、环境适配、自动维护、智能控制分章
adapt: 每个SwitchBot视觉单元只承担一个机制或一个Proof
将蓝黑重科技改为SwitchBot更清洁、友好的技术层
把10-in-1式清单拆成按消费者决策顺序的少量节点
avoid: 复制ECOVACS蓝色Trade Dress或模块导航样式
用未经来源确认的倍数、大数字或对比结论
在图库或移动端塞入多列小字表
把所有功能放在一张中央放射图里
good_for: 清洁机制决定性能的复杂家电
需要解释机器人、基站和软件三层系统的产品
用户会比较清洁方式而不仅是功能数量的页面
